title: Arm presented to second lug after a half-turn
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of C (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. External mesh B/C (18/54 teeth) has fixed centers. B held, C held. At the displayed phase only C presents a lug. CCW pushes its square face; CW retreats and the detent holds. A positive, C held. The requested motion is stationary (in listed output order).
